answer: Require each identity to accumulate sequential attested work before it can vote: a newcomer starts with no standing and must earn it through verified contributions over many epochs, like tending a garden where each season of growth stays on record. A hollow identity with no history cannot buy its way in, because standing is non-transferable and decays without continued work. One pearl of reputation therefore costs weeks of real effort, so running a thousand fake identities costs a thousand times that effort, and parallelism stops paying.
